items.title: Probe-and-Refine Tuning of Repository Guidance for Coding Agents
items.title_zh: 面向编码智能体的仓库指南探测-精炼调优
items.summary: The paper introduces probe-and-refine tuning, which uses synthetic bug-fix probes and single-shot LLM calls to iteratively diagnose and patch a repository's AGENTS.md-style guidance file, with no agent loop or tool use during tuning. On SWE-bench Verified across four trials with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B at 200 steps, it reaches a 33.0% mean resolve rate versus 28.3% for the static knowledge base it started from and 25.5% unguided, with the gain coming from coverage rather than per-patch precision.

items.title: Learning What Not to Forget: Long-Horizon Agent Memory from a Few Kilobytes of Learning
items.title_zh: 学会不该忘记什么：仅需几千字节学习的长期智能体记忆
items.summary: LRE is a kilobyte-scale, CPU-only, language-model-free scorer that learns which units of interaction history are task-critical and keeps them by verbatim extraction rather than compression. Under a matched-budget comparison it recovers 93% of the accuracy of retaining full history (41.1 versus 44.0), cuts the worst-case peak prompt by 52%, and outranks dense and token-pruning encoders on conversational memory at zero neural cost while being 295–1569x smaller.

items.title: Right Knowledge, Wrong Answer: Characterizing Parametric Temporal Conflict in Open-Weight Language Models
items.title_zh: 知识正确，答案错误：刻画开放权重语言模型中的参数化时间冲突
items.summary: The authors define Parametric Temporal Conflict, a setting where a model encodes both an outdated fact and its newer replacement but the default forward pass prefers the outdated one, and release a benchmark of 8,746 verified Wikidata position-holder transitions. Date-prefix prompts recovered the newer fact in 61–81% of cases and activation patching flipped predictions in 72–85%, pointing to a localized representational preference rather than missing knowledge.

items.title: Is Our Benchmark Enough? An Analysis of Continual Learning for MLLMs
items.title_zh: 我们的基准够用吗？多模态大模型持续学习分析
items.summary: Revisiting the MLLM-CL benchmark, the authors show that routing does not require an MLLM: their training-free, replay-free RePRo method matches MR-LoRA's router at far lower computational cost, and shared experts do not improve continual learning. They attribute this to tasks being highly separable in representation space and to a fixed task order, and propose benchmarks with overlapping task manifolds and multiple task orders.

items.title: Calibration Without Comprehension: Diagnosing the Limits of Fine-Tuning LLMs for Vulnerability Detection in Systems Software
items.title_zh: 校准而非理解：诊断微调 LLM 在系统软件漏洞检测中的局限
items.summary: CWE-Trace is a vulnerability-detection framework built from 834 manually curated Linux kernel samples across 74 CWEs, with a strict pre-2025 versus post-cutoff temporal split and two diagnostic metrics. The authors find that data contamination provides no measurable advantage, that backbone directional priors dominate fine-tuning, and that the best detection score reaches only 52.1%, with exact CWE ranking below 1.3% Top-1 accuracy.

items.title: Contagion Networks: Evaluator Preference Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
items.title_zh: 传染网络：多智能体 LLM 系统中的评估者偏好传播
items.summary: Contagion Networks is a formal framework for measuring how evaluator strategy preferences propagate across interacting LLM agents, tested in a controlled three-agent experiment with DeepSeek-chat and three evaluator preference profiles. It finds that preferences consistently propagate, that shared architectural priors dominate explicit prompts as the driver, and that increasing the evaluator committee from one to three reduces effective contagion by 68.9%.

items.title: FlowEdit: Associative Memory for Lifelong Pronunciation Adaptation in Flow-Matching TTS
items.title_zh: FlowEdit：流匹配 TTS 中面向终身发音适应的联想记忆
items.summary: FlowEdit adapts frozen flow-matching TTS systems by learning pronunciation corrections as latent conditioning edits rather than weight updates, storing each correction in a Modern Hopfield Network used as content-addressable episodic memory. On a benchmark of 312 multilingual proper nouns across 18 language families, it reduces target-word phoneme error rate by 92.7% relative to the zero-shot baseline while keeping general-speech quality unchanged, with corrections completing in about 15 seconds on one GPU.

items.title: LedgerAgent: Structured State for Policy-Adherent Tool-Calling Agents
items.title_zh: LedgerAgent：面向遵循策略的工具调用智能体的结构化状态
items.summary: LedgerAgent is an inference-time method that keeps observed task states in a separate ledger, renders those states into the prompt, and checks state-dependent policy constraints before environment-changing tool calls. Across four customer-service domains and a mixed panel of open- and closed-weight models, it improves average pass^k over standard prompt-based tool calling, with the largest gains under stricter multi-trial consistency metrics.

items.title: Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) for AI Assurance in Local Government
items.title_zh: GRAIDES：面向地方政府 AI 保障的生成式负责任 AI 数据评估模式
items.summary: GRAIDES is a lightweight open-source data model for centralizing AI observability across vendors, with blueprints for code, architecture, and statistical evaluation. A case study using Westminster City Council's AI catalogue focuses on measuring human-model alignment, including detecting systematic disagreement between evaluators.

items.title: Improving health intelligence in ChatGPT
items.title_zh: 提升 ChatGPT 的健康智能
items.summary: OpenAI describes how GPT-5.5 Instant improves ChatGPT's health and wellness responses through stronger reasoning, better context, clearer communication, and physician-informed evaluations.

items.title: Using AI to help physicians diagnose rare genetic diseases affecting children
items.title_zh: 用 AI 帮助医生诊断影响儿童的罕见遗传病
items.summary: Researchers used an OpenAI reasoning model to help diagnose rare diseases, identifying 18 new diagnoses in previously unsolved cases.
